hooks.command: f=$(python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))"); case "$f" in *.py) .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff format "$f" 2>&1; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check --fix "$f" 2>&1 ;; esac

PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; out=$("$PY" -m ruff check . 2>&1 && "$PY" -m mypy src 2>&1 && "$PY" -m pytest -q 2>&1); status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then tail=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -c 1500); python -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'make check fallo (lint/typecheck/test) - revisa antes de commitear:\n' + sys.argv[1]}))" "$tail"; fi
